title: Zhuangzi, Outer 4 (Zaiyou): 撄 is the hand that should not have moved
desc: 在宥 is not a slogan against government. 撄 is 手＋婴声, to touch and disturb: the charge is not on the wrong content but on the fact that a hand moved.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 5 (Tiandi): 机心 is a heart that sees the world as a machine
desc: 机 is the crossbow release, so 机心 is a worldview, not greed. 刳心 scoops the installed set out; 純白不備 is a loss of wholeness, not of a virtue.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 6 (Tiandao): 积 means stockpiling, and what stocks up can be taken
desc: 天道 repeats 無所積 three times. Anything that 積s becomes stealable — the same worry as 胠篋's 利器. 糟魄 is 粕: writing is what was left after extraction.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 7 (Tianyun): the straw dog's problem is not that it is fake
desc: 芻狗 matters because it has a 用完之后. 蘧廬 is a room for one night; 迹豈履哉 — the six classics are footprints, not steps; 風化 works by resonance.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 8 (Keyi): carving a shape into your mind, then cutting yourself to fit
desc: 刻意 is the image first and the person adjusted after. 故 is precedent, not 'on purpose'. 熊經鳥申 is the earliest written daoyin posture — and not spoken of with contempt.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 9 (Shanxing): a title that argues against its own title
desc: 繕 is to patch, and a patched thing is not an original thing — the title contains its own objection. 恬 and 知 feed each other; 儻來 strips 富貴名位 of causality.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 10 (Qiushui): 自多 is a disease of scale, not of character
desc: If 自多 is a scale error the cure is a larger frame, not humility. 拘於虛 puts the limit in the address, not the intelligence; 落馬首 draws the 天/人 line on a body.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 11 (Zhile): 至乐无乐 means the ruler is put down
desc: 至樂無樂 is not numbness: it is no longer measuring joy against suffering. 惛惛 is the bill for longevity; 誙誙然 is the shape of a crowd; 褚小綆短 is capacity and reach.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 12 (Dasheng): 达 is understanding, not prolonging
desc: 達生 is not 養生; 無以為 means 'no use', not 'helpless'. 神全 is being uncut; 以黃金注者殙 is the empirical proof that this is not a skill.

title: Zhuangzi, Outer 13 (Shanmu): the empty boat is the argument that does not happen
desc: 不材 quotes its price from outside. 一龍一蛇 is not 'flexible' — 無肯專為 refuses specialization. 皮 is the identity you cannot put down: 魯侯's is 魯國.
